Class Board

java.lang.Object
com.splendor.model.Board
public class Board extends Object
Represents the game board containing all shared resources and cards. Manages the gem bank, card decks for each tier, and available noble tiles.

      public void setAvailableCards(Map<Integer, List<Card>> availableCards)

    • drawBlindCard

      public Card drawBlindCard(int tier)
      Draws the top card from the specified tier's deck without placing it in the face-up slots. Used for blind deck-reserve moves where the player takes the card directly into their hand without it touching the board display.
      Parameters:
      tier - Deck tier to draw from (1, 2, or 3).
      Returns:
      The drawn card, or null if the deck is empty.

    • copyDecks

      public Map<Integer, List<Card>> copyDecks()
      Returns a shallow copy of the internal card decks as a tier-to-list map. Each list contains the remaining face-down cards in queue order. Used by the snapshot mechanism to capture deck state for undo.
      Returns:
      A new map containing copied lists of remaining cards per tier.

    • restoreDecks

      public void restoreDecks(Map<Integer, List<Card>> decks)
      Restores all tier decks from a previously captured snapshot map, rebuilding the internal LinkedList queues from the snapshot lists. Used by the undo/restore mechanism.
      Parameters:
      decks - Snapshot map of tier (1–3) to ordered card list.
